methodology.event_time_rule: first_seen_at must fall in days 1-15 of the calendar month after revenue_month
methodology.effective_trade_rule: always start evaluation from the next TAIEX trading day after observed_date
methodology.return_rule: D1/D3/D5/D10/D20 compare target close with the close immediately before the effective trading day
methodology.historical_backfill_rule: backfilled first_seen_at values outside the reporting window are excluded to avoid look-ahead bias
methodology.stock_price_rule: use unified provider priority: TWSE MI_INDEX, data_history_sma, legacy data_fubon
